scope: R4 idle-to-healthy-work transition, captured subprocess ownership and canonical claim closure only

assessment.finding: Strict idle remains the pre-spawn admission contract. The post-spawn branch delegates to the exact pinned healthy-work guard with the current binding and reservation, as requested; allowing ordinary hosted inference after admission is intentional.

The local process handle exists before ownership registration; the transition callback runs only after registered returns. A registration or callback error still reaches local finally cleanup, and uncertain owned absence retains the canonical claim.

Every check, before admission and after transition, checks MemAvailable>=20GiB in addition to lease identity, pinned health/coordination guard, early guard, observed GPU-lease identity and qualification pin. Private phase, owner/profile/fault/resource changes are not replaced by an idle-only exemption.

Claim release follows positive owned absence and exact own-record comparison. Final check and successful supervision precede result publication. The cpu_started flag staying true through closure preserves the intended healthy ordinary-work policy without losing phase or owner checks.

Source controls cover guard branch selection, guard failure propagation, memory boundary parsing and registration-before-transition ordering. These are mocked controls, not actual R4 physical execution evidence.

bounded_limitations: No execution, project import, tests, staging, SSH, native/GPU work or source edits performed. Only the two requested local source files were read.
No routine qualification-map review, output/input pin acceptance, build-tree continuation admission or model/runtime promotion is granted.
No concrete newly introduced lost-group, insufficient late-guard or claim-release bug identified in the inspected R4 transition.
Actual continuation still requires the separately requested fresh both-host R4 CPU proofs, exact input/output review and fresh compile-r4 evidence namespace.
